lines.en: label utadate35:
I tap on Uta’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Uta 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: It’s still early, so the chances of her being asleep are pretty high. But, then again-
lines.zh: 时间还早，她还在睡的可能性相当高。不过，话说回来——

lines.en: : Hello? Sensei?
lines.zh: : 喂？Sensei？

lines.en: : Hold on. Inner monologue isn’t done yet.
lines.zh: : 等一下。内心独白还没说完呢。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I get it.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。我明白了。

lines.en: But, then again, with the archery club actually being the only {i}real{/i} club at Kumon-mi High and Uta being the ace of it, I wouldn’t be surprised if she was already on her way over there.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，弓道部好歹是 Kumon-mi 高中唯一一个{i}正经{/i}社团，而 Uta 又是社里的王牌，所以就算她已经在往那边走了，我也不会觉得意外。

lines.en: Which, by the sound of it, she likely is.
lines.zh: 而且听这动静，她八成真在路上了。

lines.en: : Okay. Done. Please continue.
lines.zh: : 好了。说完了。请继续。

lines.en: : Continue what? You called {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 继续什么？是你打给{i}我{/i}的。

lines.en: : Oh, right. What are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你现在在干什么？

lines.en: : Right now? Talking to you and attempting to put my socks on with one hand. It’s way harder than it sounds.
lines.zh: : 现在？一边跟你讲话，一边单手穿袜子。这比听起来难多了。

lines.en: : Exciting. What else are you wearing?
lines.zh: : 真刺激。你还穿着什么别的？

lines.en: : Thaaaaat would be a secret, Sensei. But it’d be easier to guess what I am {i}not{/i} wearing.
lines.zh: : 那~可~是~秘~密~哦，Sensei。不过猜我「{i}没{/i}」穿什么倒是更容易些。

lines.en: : Of course it would be easier to guess that. You literally just told me you were still putting your socks on. Which means you are either not wearing socks or...you’re just weird and you wear more than one pair.
lines.zh: : 那当然更容易猜了。你刚刚才亲口说还在穿袜子，也就是说你要么没穿袜子，要么……你就是个怪人，一次穿两双。

lines.en: : Not...really what I was...uhh...
lines.zh: : 不……我说的不是……呃……

lines.en: : Anyway! Why are you callin’ so early? What can little ole’ Uta do for ya?
lines.zh: : 总之！你这么早打电话来干嘛？小小的 Uta 能为您做点什么呢？

lines.en: : She can stop whatever she’s doing right now and come hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 她可以停下手里的一切，马上过来陪我。

lines.en: : I can’t even put on socks first?
lines.zh: : 我连袜子都不能先穿完吗？

lines.en: : Depends on if it’s your first or second pair.
lines.zh: : 那得看这是你第一双还是第二双。

lines.en: : Also, wait- no! I have practice this morning. Miss Watabe will probably tie me up and do weird things to me if I’m late.
lines.zh: : 还有，等等——不行！我今天早上有训练。要是迟到了，Watabe 小姐大概会把我绑起来，对我做些奇怪的事。

lines.en: : That should be even more of a reason to show up late.
lines.zh: : 那不是更应该故意迟到吗。

lines.en: : You know, you’re kinda right. That doesn’t sound so bad apart from the part where I’d be betraying Osako-chan and she could kick my head off.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，你说的也有点道理。除了会背叛 Osako 酱、还可能被她一脚踢飞脑袋这点之外，听起来倒不赖。

lines.en: : I really can’t hang out, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真的不能出去玩啦。

lines.en: : I really think you should.
lines.zh: : 我真的觉得你应该来。

lines.en: : Ngh. Ain’t teachers supposed to talk their students {i}out{/i} of skipping school-stuff? What do you think you’re doing here? What’s your end game, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 唔嗯。老师不是应该劝学生{i}别{/i}逃掉学校活动吗？你到底在干什么啊？你的最终目的是什么，Sensei？

lines.en: : My end game is just getting you to choose me over your responsibilities. It’s the ego boost I need first thing in the morning.
lines.zh: : 我的最终目的就是让你在我和你的责任之间选我。这是我一大早最需要的那点自我满足。

lines.en: : Plus, you’ve yet to come to my house while no one else is home and I think the time has come.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你还没趁别人都不在家的时候来过我家，我觉得时机到了。

lines.en: : PFBPFBPFBFBFFBGHGHB!?!??!?!!? WHAT?!
lines.zh: : PFBPFBPFBFBFFBGHGHB！？！？？！？！！？什么？！

lines.en: : What even was that?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么动静？

lines.en: : I just spit my friggin’ tea all over my bed, that’s what! You’re inviting me to your house?!
lines.zh: : 我刚把该死的茶喷了满床，就是这个动静！你是在邀请我去你家？！

lines.en: : Yeah.
: While no one else is home?! It would be just the two of us?!
lines.zh: : 趁别人都不在家？！就我们两个人？！

lines.en: : That is what is happening, yes.
lines.zh: : 事情就是这样，没错。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how many phone calls I have to make now?! Do you have any idea what you’ve done?!
lines.zh: : 你知道我现在得打多少个电话吗？！你知道你干了什么好事吗？！

lines.en: : Are you coming or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？

lines.en: : No! No way! That’s the point of no return! I don’t know what kinda crazy morning wood you had to wake up with to propose something like this, but it’s not happening! No way!
lines.zh: : 不要！绝对不行！那可是不能回头的那条线！我不知道你今早是晨勃到什么程度才提出这种事，但这不可能发生！想都别想！

lines.en: : I bet you’d come over if I was that talking sponge you used to have a crush on.
lines.zh: : 要是我是你以前暗恋过的那块会说话的海绵，我打赌你早就来了。

lines.en: : Stop bringing up the sponge!
lines.zh: : 别再提海绵了！

lines.en: : If you’re not going to come over, could you at least meet up with me somewhere?
lines.zh: : 如果你不肯来我家，那至少找个地方跟我见一面？

lines.en: : Ugh...why are you so pushy today? And why does it have to be when I already have a thing to do?
lines.zh: : 呃……你今天怎么这么黏人？而且还偏偏赶在我已经有安排的时候？

lines.en: : Because I know you’ll cave and choose me if I keep pestering you about it.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道，只要我一直缠着你，你就会让步、然后选我。

lines.en: : Mngh...
lines.zh: : 唔嗯……

lines.en: : And I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 而且我想见你。

lines.en: : {size=-15}I want to see you too...{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-15}我也想见你……{/size}

lines.en: : Say that again?
lines.zh: : 再说一遍？

lines.en: : Aaah! I said meet me at the park! Bye!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我说在公园见！拜拜！

lines.en: scene black
Uta hangs up the phone and my first victory of the day comes as soon as I wake up.
lines.zh: Uta 挂断了电话，而我刚一睁眼，就拿下了一天中的第一场胜利。

lines.en: scene sky
I feel a little guilty about making her skip the one [[non-extortionate] thing she’s really good at, but it will all be worth it soon enough.
lines.zh: 让她翘掉那件[[不敲竹杠的]她真正擅长的事，我心里多少有点过意不去，不过很快就会值回票价。

lines.en: Because after the bashfulness wears thin and the first few steps in cracking her mask of reluctance have been made, she’ll be something worth treasuring.
lines.zh: 因为等她的羞涩褪去、等她那层不情愿的伪装被敲开几道裂缝之后，她就会变成一个值得珍藏的人。

lines.en: She’s that right now, of course. But she can be {i}more.{/i}
lines.zh: 她现在当然也是。但她还能{i}更进一步{/i}。

lines.en: And I know she {i}wants{/i} to be more.
lines.zh: 而且我知道她{i}想{/i}更进一步。

lines.en: I can feel it when she’s near.
lines.zh: 她在我身边的时候，我能感觉到。

lines.en: I can see it in her eyes and hear it when she speaks.
lines.zh: 我能从她的眼睛里看出来，能从她说话的声音里听出来。

lines.en: And it feeds the evil part of me.
lines.zh: 而那喂养着我内心邪恶的那一面。

lines.en: I had a dream last night.
lines.zh: 我昨晚做了一个梦。

lines.en: That dream made me wake up hungry.
lines.zh: 那个梦让我醒来时饿得发慌。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene1
: There...are you happy now? You got a teenage girl to skip morning practice for you.
lines.zh: : 这下……你满意了吧？你让一个高中女生为了你翘掉了晨练。

lines.en: : You look nice today.
lines.zh: : 你今天很好看。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene2
: Th...Thanks...but...I don’t know if it’s the best idea to say that sort of stuff with all these people around. They might get the wrong idea about us.
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢……不过……在人这么多的地方说这种话，我觉得不太合适。他们可能会误会我们的关系。

lines.en: : That’s kind of the point.
lines.zh: : 那不正是目的所在吗。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene3
: Well if your {i}point{/i} is trying to get yourself in trouble, you’re pretty darn close to making your dreams a reality, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果你的{i}目的{/i}是给自己惹上麻烦，那你离梦想成真已经相当近了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Yeah, it’s probably for the best if that {i}doesn’t{/i} happen. We can come close, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊，最好还是{i}别{/i}走到那一步。不过我们可以无限接近。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene4
: Huh? Close to what? I feel like I’m missin’ some context here.
lines.zh: : 嗯？接近什么？我怎么觉得自己漏了点上下文。

lines.en: : You are. And you should. But that doesn’t concern you right now as we’re here on a date and we’re supposed to look like we enjoy each other’s company.
lines.zh: : 你确实漏了。也该漏。不过现在这不关你的事，因为我们是在约会，而且我们该表现得像是享受彼此的陪伴。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene5
: Ah! I knew this was a date! You tricked me into meeting you here by throwing out an idea like coming over to your place because you knew I’d refuse and have to meet you in public instead!
lines.zh: : 啊！我就知道这是约会！你是先抛出「来我家」这种点子，明知道我会拒绝，逼我只能改在公共场合见面，就这样把我骗到这儿来的！

lines.en: : Uta, I can be a very calculating person at times. That much is inarguable. But you are giving me way too much credit and putting way too much thought into what I’m actually calculating.
lines.zh: : Uta，我有时候确实是个很会算计的人。这一点无可辩驳。但你把我想得太高明，也把我的算计想得太深了。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene6
: Is this...really okay?
lines.zh: : 这样……真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : Why would it not be okay?
lines.zh: : 为什么会有问题？

lines.en: : Because you have Io. And Maya. And Chika.
lines.zh: : 因为你有 Io。还有 Maya。还有 Chika。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene7
: And Ayane and Makoto and Futaba and Imani and Nodoka and Touka and Noriko and Kirin and-
lines.zh: : 还有 Ayane、Makoto、Futaba、Imani、Nodoka、Touka、Noriko、Kirin，还有——

lines.en: : Okay, I get it. I’m...talking to a bunch of girls. But it’s not like I’m involved with all of them.
lines.zh: : 好了，我懂了。我……在跟一堆女孩子来往。但我又不是跟她们所有人都有关系。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene8
: But...{i}some{/i} of them?
lines.zh: : 可是……跟其中{i}一些{/i}有？

lines.en: : Why does it matter who I am with any of them when I’m with you right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在是跟你在一起，那我跟她们谁在一起又有什么关系？

lines.en: scene utaparkscene9
: Because...they’re my friends...
lines.zh: : 因为……她们是我的朋友……

lines.en: : And the way you’re acting today is...making me feel like you’re kind of, just...
lines.zh: : 而且你今天的态度……让我觉得你有点……只是……

lines.en: : Like you think I’m...
lines.zh: : 就像你觉得我是……

lines.en: : Do you want it to be a date or not? Because it doesn’t have to be. We can just hang out like...any other platonic couple of...an adult male and a high school girl.
lines.zh: : 你想让这成为一场约会吗？因为也不一定非得是。我们可以就像……任何其他柏拉图式的……成年男人和高中女生那样，单纯地一起玩。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene10
: The...the people around us are probably looking at this as some sort of compensated dating thing...You know that, right?
lines.zh: : 周围的人大概会把这看成某种援助交际吧……你知道的，对吧？

lines.en: : Does that make you uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 那让你不舒服吗？

lines.en: : Does that make {i}you{/i} uncomfortable? Because it’s one thing for people to look at me as...desperate for cash or...just...just {i}easy{/i} or something, but...
lines.zh: : 那让{i}你{/i}不舒服吗？因为被别人看成……急着用钱，或者……或者很{i}随便{/i}什么的，那是另一回事，但……

lines.en: : It’s kind of...always buried in the back of my mind that people are going to look at me that way anyway, so...
lines.zh: : 这种想法……一直都埋在我心底最深处，反正别人迟早也会这么看我，所以……

lines.en: : So you’re the one I’m worried about right now...
lines.zh: : 所以我现在担心的是你……

lines.en: : You don’t have to worry about me, Uta. I’m old enough to make my own decisions.
lines.zh: : 你不用担心我，Uta。我已经大到能自己做决定了。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene11
: And I, unfortunately...am not. Not for a few more years at least. Or until I get off my parents’ phone plan.
lines.zh: : 而我，很遗憾……还不行。至少还得再过几年。或者得等我脱离父母的手机套餐。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene12
: I’ll stop dragging down the mood now, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不再扫兴了。

lines.en: : But...to...to get back to the {i}date{/i} thing...could we maybe, like...{i}not{/i} call it that? Because that makes it feel like I’m doing something wrong and...
lines.zh: : 但……再……回到{i}约会{/i}这件事上……我们能不能……{i}别{/i}这么叫它？因为这么一叫，就感觉我在做什么错事，而且……

lines.en: : And just meeting up is fine if nothing happens, right? Like, this isn’t me going behind anybody’s back or...or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 而且只要什么都没发生，单纯见个面就没问题，对吧？就像，这不算我背着谁偷偷摸摸，或者……或者类似的事。

lines.en: : This is, like...this is normal. I’m not...I’m not jumping the gun or...like...l...leading you on or...something?
lines.zh: : 这就……这很正常。我没有……我没有操之过急，或者……或者……在钓着你、给你虚假的期待……什么的？

lines.en: : You look way too nervous for a girl who is platonically meeting her platonic friend in the park on their way to go do...platonic things.
lines.zh: : 对一个只是和柏拉图式的朋友在公园里柏拉图式地见面、然后一起去做柏拉图式事情的女孩来说，你看起来紧张过头了。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene13
: Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢……

lines.en: : And...and sorry for being weird about this. And...I guess I’ll just apologize in advance for every other meeting we have like this in the future, where I will also be flighty and awkward.
lines.zh: : 还有……抱歉我在这件事上这么别扭。而且……我想我还是提前为以后每一次这样的见面道个歉吧，反正我每次都会一样轻浮又笨拙。

lines.en: : Which isn’t me assuming there will be more meetings like this in the future, of course. Just...you know. Precaution.
lines.zh: : 当然，这并不代表我认定以后还会有更多这样的见面。只是……你知道的。以防万一。

lines.en: : I...I kind of have to be careful because I...you know...I’ve got a history of...bad decisions and-
lines.zh: : 我……我必须小心一点，因为我……你知道的……我有过……做错误决定的前科，而且——

lines.en: : You’re dragging down the mood again.
lines.zh: : 你又开始扫兴了。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene14
: God, I know. I’m the worst compensated date ever. There isn’t even any compensation involved.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我知道。我是史上最差劲的援交对象。连「援」的部分都没有。

lines.en: scene black
: You can compensate me by joining me over there where there are less people to eavesdrop on us.
lines.zh: : 你可以补偿我一下——跟我到那边去，那里偷听我们说话的人少些。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei. I- wait a minute! Ain’t it me who’s supposed to be getting compensated?!
lines.zh: : 谢了，Sensei。我——等等！该拿到补偿的人不是我吗？！

lines.en: : Probably not something you should yell in broad daylight.
lines.zh: : 这种话大概不该在大白天喊出来。

lines.en: : I...hahah! Nothing to see here, folks! That’s just...that’s my older brother! Haha! We’re just friends!
lines.zh: : 我……哈哈哈！各位没什么好看的！那只是……那是我哥！哈哈！我们只是朋友！

lines.en: : You’re making it worse.
lines.zh: : 你越描越黑了。

lines.en: : Yeah, because you abandoned me when I needed you most!
lines.zh: : 对啊，谁让你在我最需要你的时候抛弃了我！

lines.en: scene utaparkscene15
: Hah...
Uta and I retreat to a corner of the park where the passersby are minimal, leaving us to wallow in momentary self-pity and stifled arousal.
lines.zh: Uta 和我退到公园的一个角落，这边路人稀少，只剩下我们沉浸在短暂的自怜和压抑的躁动里。

lines.en: And yes, I may have jumped the gun by using her obvious feelings for me as bait in an attempt to reel her in, but things are clearly a little more complicated than that, and...
lines.zh: 是的，我拿她对我显而易见的感情当诱饵，想借此把她钓过来，这确实有点操之过急，但事情显然比这复杂得多，而且……

lines.en: And I didn’t really think about how this would look from her perspective.
lines.zh: 而且我真的没有想过，从她的角度看这会是什么样子。

lines.en: It wasn’t all that long ago where she was opening up about her past to me. And for me to learn all of that and subsequently jump to “You should come over to my place” isn’t really a good look.
lines.zh: 就在不久之前，她才刚刚对我敞开心扉，讲起她的过去。而我得知了那些之后，紧接着就跳到「你该来我家」这一步，这实在不太好看。

lines.en: It’s an accurate one. That I won’t deny. But it’s not {i}good.{/i}
lines.zh: 这倒是如实反映了我心里所想。这点我不否认。但这并不{i}好{/i}。

lines.en: And I can {i}be good{/i} now.
lines.zh: 而我现在可以{i}变好{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, that didn’t go perfectly.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这事进展得不算完美。

lines.en: {i}She’s just so attractive.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她实在太诱人了。{/i}

lines.en: : No. But, on the bright side, I gained a little sister.
lines.zh: : 不完美。不过往好的方面想，我多了个妹妹。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene16
: You wouldn’t want me as an actual little sister, Sensei. I was a big ole pain in my brother’s butt growing up.
lines.zh: : 你不会真想让我当你妹妹的，Sensei。我小时候可是我哥的大麻烦。

lines.en: : Not enough of a pain for him to avoid getting arrested for defending your honor.
lines.zh: : 麻烦得还不够多，没拦住他为了维护你的名声而被人抓走。

lines.en: : I don’t have any {i}honor.{/i} And siblings kind of just look out for one another regardless of their relationship.
lines.zh: : 我没有什么{i}名声{/i}。而且兄弟姐妹本来就会互相照应，不管关系如何。

lines.en: scene happy1
scene o
scene happy2
scene utaparkscene17
: Still, though...we had a good relationship. Even {i}if{/i} I was annoying.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……我们关系挺好的。{i}就算{/i}我以前挺烦人。

lines.en: : It was always out of admiration at least. Just the...typical “little sibling trying to impress big sibling” kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 至少那一直是出于崇拜。就是那种……典型的「小屁孩想讨大哥哥欢心」的把戏。

lines.en: : I really hope he’s doing okay. It’d be nice if you got to meet him one day.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望他现在过得好。要是有一天你能见见他就好了。

lines.en: : Sure. I can introduce myself as your {i}new{/i} brother and the reason your education has plateaued.
lines.zh: : 好啊。我可以自我介绍说是你的{i}新{/i}哥哥，以及你学业停滞不前的原因。

lines.en: scene utaparkscene18
: {i}Or{/i} you could introduce yourself as my teacher. {i}Without{/i} the plateau part.
